meta.effect_text: Corner-only Drafting Room; re-rolls the rarity of 3 rooms in your pool each time you draft it. Implemented as a one-time effect when the Conservatory itself is drafted: 3 random undealt deck cards each roll a fresh rarity (uniform over the 4 rarities; the real re-roll distribution is unpublished - inferred) via the dedicated conservatory_reroll RNG substream, and changed cards move to the new rarity's deck of the same free/gem class at a random undealt position (reinsertion point also inferred). Reachable only via its Found Floorplan: a hidden dig spot at the campsite, found on arrival while holding a shovel (special_items.py::on_area_arrival), which permanently adds it to the draft pool from the following day (decks.py::eligible_pool, pool == "found_floorplan"). Its own rarity cannot be changed by the Conservatory or the Gear Wrench (unmodelled remodel-consumption mechanic; see docs/open_tasks.md).

Contains one doorway per Mechanical room in the estate, including itself: the first door always faces back the way it was drafted from, and up to three more spawn forward/left/right in that order, each skipped without consuming its slot when the neighbouring room has no facing door. The door count is fixed the moment the room is drafted. Layout is cross (wiki infobox: Shape=4-way), not a guess -- but the effective door count is 1-8; doors beyond the four cardinal ones open diagonal compartments with a deterministic, priority-ordered loot list (a West Antechamber Lever, then a key item, then an Upgrade Disk, then a Sanctum Key -- modelled as containers at this room's cell, see engine/effects/rooms/mechanarium.py and engine/special_items.py). interior_only covers the 'center 21 tiles' constraint.
Ending the day in the Planetarium grants 2 Stars, tracked in state.stars and carried forward day to day. Telescope and cross-day constellation interactions are out of scope.

Whenever you enter this room, lose one random special inventory item; the room grants item draws from its own pool in return (count varies 2-4 per the wiki's ladder mechanic). Contains 2 rare items. Modeled in engine/special_items.py's on_enter dispatcher (lost_and_found_on_enter, gated on Capability.LOST_AND_FOUND), not the effects tag array, since it must run after this room's own guaranteed-item grant. PLACEMENT NOTE: wiki restricts horizontal drafting at rank 1 only; no_horizontal_end_rank also blocks rank 9 horizontal outside corners (slight over-restriction).

The Treasure Trove permanently gains a 5 Gold Coin pile every time it is drafted, and each draft collects the whole surface: the Nth draft this attempt pays 5*N coins. The pile count caps at 32 (blueprince.wiki.gg/wiki/Treasure_Trove), so a single draft is worth at most 160 coins -- and every draft after the 32nd keeps paying the full 160 rather than nothing. The cap bounds the PER-DRAFT payout, not the attempt total (the first 32 drafts alone come to 2640 coins). Granted at draft time rather than on entry, keyed off the cumulative per-attempt draft count. Key of Aries, the black chest, coin-pile visual loot, and memo chests remain out of scope.

All doorways in this room are security locked regardless of security level. APPROXIMATION: the lock system is out of scope; no effect modeled. Mora Jai box / Lock Pick Kit contents reduced to standard item slots. PLACEMENT NOTE: wiki restricts E/W drafting at rank 1 only; no_horizontal_end_rank also blocks rank 9 horizontal outside corners (slight over-restriction).

'Reclaim the crown' — cross-day meta-progression objective (Throne of the Blue Prince transformation); the crown objective itself is out of scope. Two effects ARE modelled: the north Antechamber lever (effects/rooms/throne_room.py, via provides_lever) and the Mora Jai box's +2 allowance (allowance_token_throne_room, guaranteed_in). Also contains the Sanctum Key and random valuables (reduced to standard item slots). PLACEMENT NOTE: 'cannot be rotated / must face the throne head-on' needs a fixed-orientation mechanic the sim lacks; left permissive on orientation. rank_gte_2 + rank_lte_8 cover the rank 1/9 restriction.

While drafting from a Tunnel, always draw another Tunnel (chain drafting). MODELED: opening the north door of a placed Tunnel force-deals a single forced Tunnel option (no RNG, slot 0 cost 0, orientation N|S); chain ends when Tunnel is illegal at the target (rank 9 blocked by rank_lte_8). NOT MODELED: southward Tunnel chains (direction not confirmed); rank-1/9 exceptional drafts with gem rewards; library gem-gate (no draw when holding >=2 gems); dig_spots luck scaling (fixed at 3).

meta.notes: Experiment-added copy of the Aquarium, injected by the Laboratory's add_aquariums effect ('add 3 Aquariums to today's draft pool'). Wiki (Aquarium, "Other interactions"): "These additional copies are identical to the originals except that they cannot be drafted in certain positions from certain directions, possibly due to a bug or oversight. Specifically, they cannot be drafted southwards in the two Rank 1 locations adjacent to the Entrance Hall, and cannot be drafted northwards into the Rank 9 locations adjacent to the Antechamber." Modeled via the experiment_aquarium draft condition (cells 1/3 blocked southward, cells 41/43 blocked northward). Inert until add_aquariums itself is implemented (PR3): pool_temp keeps this record out of every deck build in the meantime.
